title: Young Boy Posing with Animal Statue, 1948 Los Angeles B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Los Angeles July 1948

45 A

TRADE MARK REG. THE FOX CO. SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS

THE FOX CO.
SAN ANTONIO, TEX.
AUG. 1948
description: A charming mid-century summer snapshot depicting a young boy in a striped t-shirt resting beside a large stone sculpture of a roaring animal, surrounded by park foliage and bright sunlight. The print features a classic Fox Company Greek fret border. Annotations on the back record the photograph as being taken in Los Angeles in July 1948 and developed by The Fox Co. in San Antonio, Texas, in August 1948.
